description: Figure 8(d) is a line plot that illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on Qwen2.5. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and ranges from 60% to 80%. The plot includes five lines representing different editing methods: Base, MEND, FT, MEMIT, and IKE. The Base line, which represents the LLM without editing, starts at approximately 70% accuracy and ends at around 75% accuracy. The MEND line starts at about 65% and ends near 70%. The FT line begins at around 60% and finishes close to 65%. The MEMIT line starts at approximately 65% and ends near 70%. The IKE line begins at about 60% and ends close to 65%. The lines show a general trend of increasing accuracy as the co-occurrence number increases, with the MEMIT and IKE methods showing the most significant improvement.
